movable_parts.name: sm_surgicalchair_a01_seat_01
movable_parts.motion: The entire seat assembly swivels freely around the central column.

movable_parts.name: sm_surgicalchair_a01_seat_01
movable_parts.motion: The seat slides up and down the central column for height adjustment.

movable_parts.name: sm_surgicalchair_a01_wheel1_01
movable_parts.motion: The caster wheel assembly swivels around its vertical mounting post. This applies to all five wheels (wheel1 through wheel5).

movable_parts.name: sm_surgicalchair_a01_wheel1_tires_01
movable_parts.motion: The wheel rolls around its horizontal axle. This applies to all five wheels (wheel1 through wheel5).

special_notes: This is a complex articulated object. The seat has two degrees of freedom relative to the base: continuous swivel and prismatic height adjustment, both along the Z-axis. Each of the five caster wheels has two degrees of freedom: swivel around a local Z-axis and roll around a local Y-axis.
